newsitem.title: USA: Wash. Water continues to restore power.
newsitem.headline: Wash. Water continues to restore power.

text.p: About 15,000 electricity customers in the Spokane, Wash., area were still without service late Tuesday following last week's storm-related outages, Washington Water Power Co reported Wednesday.
The company said crews restored service to about 2,000 customers in Spokane on Tuesday.
In Coeur d'Alene, about 200 customers were still without service.
The company said it hoped to restore service to the majority of customers by Thanksgiving.
Last Tuesday about 47 Spokane-area distribution feeders were out of service following the heavy rains and winds.
Washington Water serves eastern Washington and northern Idaho.
